_comment: Only sources listed in CLAUDE.md. Bands are checked in order: the first whose 'below' exceeds the value wins; a band without 'below' takes the rest. 'limits' = physically plausible input range for validation, NOT a medical threshold.

heart_rate.label: Heart rate
heart_rate.source_title: American Heart Association, All About Heart Rate

bands.label: Below 60
bands.guidance: Below the typical resting range. Common in fit people; consider a re-check at rest and watch your baseline trend.

bands.label: 60-100 resting
bands.guidance: Within the typical resting range (sitting or lying, calm).

bands.label: Above 100
bands.guidance: Above the typical resting range. Rest calmly and re-check; if it stays high, consider contacting flight surgeons.

bands.label: Normal (<120)
bands.guidance: Systolic in the normal range.

bands.label: Elevated (120-129)
bands.guidance: Elevated. Categories are based on an average of 2+ readings on 2+ occasions; keep monitoring.

bands.label: Stage 1 range (130-139)
bands.guidance: In the stage 1 range. Re-check seated and rested; categories need repeated readings.

bands.label: Stage 2 range (140-180)
bands.guidance: In the stage 2 range. Re-check; if repeated readings stay here, contact flight surgeons.

bands.label: Severe range (>180)
bands.guidance: Severe range. Contact flight surgeons now, especially with chest pain, breathlessness, weakness or vision changes.

bands.label: Normal (<80)
bands.guidance: Diastolic in the normal range.

bands.label: Stage 1 range (80-89)
bands.guidance: In the stage 1 range. Re-check seated and rested; categories need repeated readings.

bands.label: Stage 2 range (90-120)
bands.guidance: In the stage 2 range. Re-check; if repeated readings stay here, contact flight surgeons.

bands.label: Severe range (>120)
bands.guidance: Severe range. Contact flight surgeons now, especially with chest pain, breathlessness, weakness or vision changes.

glucose_fasting.label: Fasting glucose
glucose_fasting.source_title: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes 2026 (Sec. 2 criteria; Sec. 6 Table 6.4 hypoglycemia levels)

bands.label: Level 2 low (<54)
bands.guidance: Level 2 low glucose range. Consider fast-acting glucose and contact flight surgeons now.

bands.label: Level 1 low (54-69)
bands.guidance: Level 1 low glucose range. Consider fast-acting carbohydrate and re-check in 15 min.

bands.label: 70-99 fasting
bands.guidance: Fasting value below the impaired-fasting range.

bands.label: 100-125 fasting
bands.guidance: In the impaired-fasting range (lab criteria, 8 h fast). Keep monitoring; a meter reading is less precise than a lab test.

bands.label: 126+ fasting
bands.guidance: At or above the fasting criterion that needs lab confirmation. Contact flight surgeons to arrange a check.

body_temp.label: Body temperature
body_temp.source_title: CDC, Definitions of Signs, Symptoms, and Conditions of Ill Travelers

bands.label: Below 38 °C
bands.guidance: Below the fever threshold.

bands.label: Fever (38 °C or more)
bands.guidance: At or above the fever threshold. Rest, hydrate, re-check, and contact flight surgeons.

body_temp.todo: low-temperature threshold: look up in NASA-STD-3001 (Vol 1 Rev C and Vol 2 Rev F checked: none for resting crew)

spo2.label: SpO₂
spo2.todo: look up in NASA-STD-3001 (Vol 2 Rev F only limits cabin PIO2, not crew SpO2)

sleep_hours.label: Sleep
sleep_hours.source_title: Jones et al., Sleep deficiency in spaceflight, SLEEP 2022;45(3)

bands.label: Under 5 h
bands.guidance: Under 5 h is associated with worse somatic state in astronauts. Prioritise rest; if it repeats, contact flight surgeons.

bands.label: 5-6 h
bands.guidance: Under 6 h is associated with slower psychomotor response in astronauts. Consider extra rest before critical tasks.

bands.label: 6 h or more
bands.guidance: At or above 6 h.

stress.label: Stress (self-report)
stress.todo: No cited threshold in the CLAUDE.md sources. Self-rated 0-10 (SNRS-11 style, validation still limited); tracked against personal baseline only.

hrv_rmssd.label: HRV (RMSSD)
hrv_rmssd.todo: No cited threshold: short-term RMSSD norms are method-dependent (Nunan et al. 2010). Entered from a chest-strap ECG or similar device, never from the camera (CLAUDE.md). Tracked against personal baseline only.

bone_tibia_bmd_pct.label: Tibia BMD change (modelled)
bone_tibia_bmd_pct.todo: Simulation only: astronauts cannot self-measure BMD (HR-pQCT scans pre/post flight). Gabel et al. 2022 report median -3.4% tibia total BMD at return; no in-flight threshold.

mood.label: Mood
mood.todo: look up in NASA OCHMO TB-016 (Rev B checked: no mood-score threshold)
